events.title: MOLTYN is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: MOLTYN is part of Steam Next Fest from 19 to 26 October, and the free demo is ready to play right now. You're a superhero in a world where everything can break. Melt it, flood it, freeze it, throw it. Every building comes down a little differently. events.title: Playtest signups are open
events.summary: The MOLTYN playtest is now taking signups. Hit Request Access on the store page (the green button in the "Join the MOLTYN Playtest" box) and you're in the queue. Access goes out as soon as the build clears Steam review. The playtest shows up in your library as MOLTYN Playtest. What you'll be testing: the current build of the game. events.title: The MOLTYN demo hits Steam next week
events.summary: Every rock, drop and flame in MOLTYN is real, simulated matter and next week you get to break it yourself!The free demo is days away: one island, seven powers, a couple of baddies, and a world that actually obeys physics. Cut a cliff and it falls. Pour lava and it cools to obsidian. Charge a water blast and the pool comes with you.Wishlist the full game so the demo finds you the moment it's live:Andrew (the whole current dev team)
